history.summary: Lowest-quantum entry in the batch ($1.0M) and below-median PSF ($1366 vs $1411), but the location is the dealbreaker for an investment hold: 1.2km from only Kangkar LRT, no MRT walking distance. The 5.41% CAGR is the weakest in the batch, confirming muted demand. Resort-style landscaping is a livability plus, not an investment thesis.
history.rating_rationale: Affordable $1.0M quantum and a sub-median PSF make it look cheap, but cheapness here reflects a connectivity penalty rather than value. The nearest rail is Kangkar LRT 1.2km away — no MRT within walking distance, which structurally suppresses both tenant demand and the resale buyer pool. At 5.41%, its resale CAGR is the lowest of all ten condos despite 139 transactions, signalling genuinely softer appreciation rather than a data artefact. Build quality and quiet, well-landscaped environment are real but are own-stay merits. For a 5-7yr investment hold the exit liquidity and growth case are simply weaker than the better-connected peers.
red_flags: No MRT within walking distance — only Kangkar LRT 1.2km away; suppresses tenant and resale demand
5.41% CAGR is the lowest in the batch despite ample transactions — structurally weaker appreciation
catalysts: Low $1.0M entry quantum widens the affordability buyer pool
Broad Sengkang/Hougang area growth and CRL (Hougang interchange) as a distant area tailwind
